sources.role: byte-pinned exact M88改+ distribution mirror containing M88.exe, readme.txt, faq.txt, INI.txt, and ENHANCED.txt
inspectable M88 2.21a base source; used where its path algorithm is also present in the exact M88改+ binary/docs
official M88kai distribution identity; returned HTTP 403 during capture

paths.path: <M88 executable directory>\<executable stem>.ini by default; an alternate .ini may be supplied by command line or drag-and-drop.
paths.naming: Windows profile INI section [M88p2 for Windows]. Renaming M88.exe changes the default to the same executable stem plus .ini; M88改+ documents BIOSPath, Directory, Joystick, XInput, DirectInput, snapshot checks, and its additional INI fields.
evidence: artifact:M88改+ readme.txt/faq.txt/INI.txt in archive sha256 305bf4a6 (default executable-stem INI and alternate INI command line)
artifact:M88.exe build 6d894532 strings (M88p2 for Windows, .ini, M88.exe, M88.ini)

paths.path: The same executable-stem INI stores DirectInput, Joystick, XInput, and KeyChange; optional 256-byte keycode.cfg is placed beside M88.exe.
paths.naming: XInput=-1 disables, 0..3 selects a device, and 16 auto-selects the first device. Joystick=-1 disables, 0..15 selects a Win32/DirectInput device, and 16 auto-selects; XInput has priority. keycode.cfg is a 256-byte virtual-key translation table generated by mkkey.exe-compatible tooling.
evidence: artifact:M88改+ readme.txt build 2021-03-11 and 2025-03-24 sections in archive sha256 305bf4a6

paths.path: The mounted .d88 disk image is opened writable when permitted and guest disk writes modify that image in place; a read-only image remains read-only. .t88 tape images are opened read-only.
paths.naming: No separate game-save sidecar. Persistence follows the user-selected .d88 filename, including multi-image D88 containers.
evidence: artifact:M88改+ readme.txt build 2015-11-21 section (disk/image writes) in archive sha256 305bf4a6
artifact:M88.exe build 6d894532 strings (Open disk image, *.d88, Open tape image, *.t88)

paths.path: <current M88 working directory>\<mounted drive-1 disk basename>_<slot>.s88; when no disk is mounted, the tape basename is used, otherwise snapshot_<slot>.s88.
paths.naming: Slots are decimal 0 through 9. The exact M88改+ binary contains .s88, %s_?.s88, and %s_%d.s88; the readme says drag-and-drop snapshots should be colocated with their .D88 image.
evidence: artifact:M88改+ readme.txt snapshot and drag-and-drop sections in archive sha256 305bf4a6

paths.path: Directory selected by BIOSPath in the executable-stem INI, otherwise the current M88 working directory.
paths.naming: The exact binary recognizes pc88.rom or split n88.rom/n80.rom/n88_0.rom..n88_3.rom, plus optional n80_2.rom, n80_3.rom, e0.rom..e8.rom, cdbios.rom, jisyo.rom, PC88.ROM/DISK.ROM, FONT.ROM, NSRFONT.ROM, HIRAFONT.ROM, KANJI1.ROM, and KANJI2.ROM. No ROM bytes or universal checksums are distributed.
evidence: artifact:M88改+ readme.txt BIOSPath/font and NSRFONT/HIRAFONT sections in archive sha256 305bf4a6

paths.naming: No cryptographic key file is documented.

linux.reason: M88kai is treated as a Windows-only artifact and no Linux build was verified.

linux-flatpak.reason: No Linux or Flatpak artifact was verified.

macos.reason: No native macOS artifact was verified.

notes: The byte-pinned mirror is an exact M88改+ 2.21a distribution, not merely an M88-family artifact. Its bundled Japanese documentation and binary establish the paths and selector grammar above; the public M88 base source is used only where the same literals/behavior are present in that artifact. A native controller writer is still intentionally absent because Joystick/XInput persist runtime enumeration indices rather than stable physical-device identities.
